newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 5,978 to dollar for Feb 6 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 5,978 to dollar for Feb 6 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate slightly weaker at 5,978 to the dollar for February 6.
The reference rate set on Tuesday is a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Monday for February 5 is 5,974 to the dollar. It was 5,970 on Tuesday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
